name: River Stablecoin
oneLiner: satUSD is River's omni-CDP stablecoin overcollateralized by BTC, ETH, BNB, and LSTs; collateral stays source-chain and satUSD is minted via LayerZero OFT.
collateral: BTC, ETH, BNB, and liquid staking tokens; no centralized stablecoin collateral accepted
pegMechanism: Omni-CDP overcollateralized by BTC, ETH, BNB, or LSTs; collateral stays on its source chain and satUSD is minted natively on the destination chain via LayerZero OFT messaging; peg maintained through stability pools, on-chain liquidations, and $1-of-collateral redemption arbitrage

oracleRisk.summary: River satUSD uses DIA price feeds with documented MAIR pricing, deviation triggers, refresh frequency, and heartbeat parameters.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: satUSD resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: River documents satUSD as an omnichain asset and bridge built on LayerZero's OFT standard, including cross-chain collateral and minting flows. Because route finality depends on the LayerZero/OFT stack, satUSD is scored as external-lock-mint.

mintAuthority.summary: satUSD (River, formerly Satoshi Protocol) is a Liquity-v1-derived omni-CDP: users lock BTC/ETH/BNB/LSTs on a source chain and LayerZero OFT messaging authorizes a native satUSD mint on the destination chain. The OFT contracts on Ethereum and Base are UUPS proxies owned by a single EOA.

controls.label: River omni-CDP borrower-operations / OFT mint
controls.capDescription: Mint capped by per-branch overcollateralized CDP debt; cross-chain mint is authorized by LayerZero OFT messages confirming source-chain collateral lockup.
controls.evidence: River docs and LayerZero integration coverage describe a Liquity-v1-style CDP whose collateral stays source-chain; OFT _lzSend/_lzReceive messages relay collateral state to authorize satUSD mint on the destination chain.

controls.label: satUSD OFT owner (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294721, owner() on the satUSD Ethereum contract (0x1958853a8be062dc4f401750eb233f5850f0d0d2, UUPS proxy with impl 0xa32313c04df2e12dcbc0b4b5ad234a2cc69d6c8d) returned 0xd3e87b4b76e6f8bff454aafc2ad3271c5b317d47; eth_getCode returned 0x (EOA). Base OFT (0x70654aad8b7734dc319d0c3608ec7b32e03fa162) owner() also returned the same EOA.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294721: owner() on satUSD ETH UUPS proxy = 0xd3e87b4b76e6f8bff454aafc2ad3271c5b317d47; eth_getCode = 0x (confirmed EOA). Base OFT owner() = same EOA. The ETH contract has an EIP-1967 implementation slot pointing to 0xa32313c04df2e12dcbc0b4b5ad234a2cc69d6c8d (no separate proxy admin). EOA ownership is issuer-standard enterprise custody (MPC/HSM indistinguishable on-chain); per brief, this does not block verification.
